verdict.summary: Issue #217 has substantially defined ownership, scope, dependencies, failure behavior, validation, rollout, and rollback, but it remains non-executable because five owner decisions are unresolved and two release trust-boundary details are unspecified.

blockingFindings.title: Required owner decisions remain unresolved
blockingFindings.details: Implementation and publication cannot begin until authenticated owner answers resolve O217-1 through O217-5: canonical implementation ownership, supported-platform matrix, unavailable-default-tier behavior, signing authority and redirect policy, and the exact retired launcher binding. The issue correctly identifies these decisions but therefore remains blocked rather than review-clean.

blockingFindings.title: Signed-manifest freshness contract is unverifiable
blockingFindings.details: The updater must reject expired metadata, but the required signed manifest fields contain no issuance time, expiry time, freshness interval, or comparable signed freshness value. The contract also lacks clock-skew and unavailable-clock behavior. Define signed freshness fields and deterministic validation policy, or remove the unsupported expiration requirement and its test.

blockingFindings.title: Archive extraction trust boundary is incomplete
blockingFindings.details: The distribution contract permits self-contained archives, but neither the signed metadata nor extraction policy identifies the archive format, expected executable entry, extracted file inventory, or rejection rules for traversal paths, absolute paths, links, special files, case collisions, and writes outside staging. The current extraction-failure test does not prove containment. Define these rules and corresponding malicious-archive coverage, or restrict the initial matrix to single-file binaries.

nonBlockingNotes: O217-1 asks the owner to identify the canonical manager repository, package or gitlink path, and authorized child repositories.
O217-2 asks the owner to approve every initial OS, architecture, shell, artifact, installation-directory, PATH, and CI-runner row.
O217-3 asks the owner to choose default behavior while the recorded medium Kimi route is decommissioned.
O217-4 asks the owner to approve the signing authority, pinned trust root, custody and rotation procedure, and redirect allowlist.
O217-5 asks the owner to identify and authorize migration of the exact retired launcher binding.
Issues #253 and #275 are explicitly blocking and currently open; #291 is intentionally deferred, and #293 correctly keeps the low tier fail-closed.
